source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check ME BIOS interface version is correct
1. Check the information of test item

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Information should be correct and still be correct after rebooting

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ls /sys/class/mei/ 2>&1; echo ---; intelmetool -m 2>&1 || echo "ME BIOS interface tool not installed"; echo ---; dmesg | grep -iE "mei|interface" | tail -20
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: read the interface revision (ME BIOS interface) via the MEI/SPS channel. The agent collects whatever MEI/SPS registers/dmesg lines are reachable; confirming the value is CORRECT requires knowing the expected value (a user-supplied baseline), so this is PARTIAL: agent returns the raw readout, user judges it against the expected ME BIOS interface.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: read-only attempt against Intel MEI/SPS registers using vendor tools (intelmetool / mei-amt-check) that may not be installed on the SUT; install/availability must be confirmed first, and the expected baseline value must be provided by the user.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies read-only MEI/SPS collection and the missing baseline, but does not implement the criterion's reboot persistence and does not prove intelmetool -m returns the required interface revision.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED because baseline, approved tool and reboot workflow were absent; its safeguards are retained but permanent BLOCKED conflicts with V3.1 readiness policy.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; keeps raw readout/user comparison but omits a concrete pre/post reboot evidence chain.
historical_reviews.coverage_audit: INVALID_RUN_NOTICE_011 records an older overlay omission only; it has no technical effect.

original_test_intent: Read the platform's ME-BIOS interface revision using an approved read-only method, compare it with the owner-provided expected value and verify the same correct value persists after an approved reboot.
original_method: Capture platform and firmware identity, query the ME-BIOS interface revision with a platform-valid read-only utility, perform one approved controlled reboot, repeat the identical query and retain raw pre/post evidence and health logs.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies the expected revision, validated tool and reboot plan and later issues the verdict. No physical or visual action is inherently required once those inputs are approved; query, reboot, reconnect, repeat query and evidence capture can be automated.
required_inputs: Exact platform/SKU, BIOS and ME/SPS identity
Authoritative expected ME-BIOS interface revision and comparison rule
Vendor/project-approved read-only utility, version and exact query syntax
Maintenance approval, active-workload check, reboot/reconnect timeout and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use only a verified read-only query; do not invoke ME/SPS write, reset, flash or provisioning functions.
Do not infer the revision from an uncorrelated sysfs directory or dmesg grep.
Preserve prior logs and obtain approval before the service-impacting reboot.
Stop on ambiguous target/output, MEI error, boot/reconnect failure or unexpected BMC/SEL event; never auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the expected value and query tool, inventory platform/firmware/MEI state and capture pre-reboot raw revision evidence.
After approval, initiate one controlled reboot, track downtime and reconnect through the planned path.
Repeat the identical read-only query, compare pre/post/expected values and collect host/BMC/SEL health while keeping the verdict engineer-owned.
engineer_actions: Supply the expected revision and validate that the chosen utility/command is read-only and platform applicable.
Approve the reboot/recovery plan and maintenance window.
Review the raw comparison and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sysfs and dmesg are useful availability diagnostics, but they may not expose the ME-BIOS interface revision. intelmetool -m platform support and field semantics are not established by the source, and the command omits the required reboot/re-query.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the owner/vendor-validated read-only interface-revision query for the exact Intel ME/SPS platform; run the same command before and after the approved reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The interface-version check, correctness and post-reboot persistence plus 5/0-minute fields are preserved; no expected number is fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a version-pinned, platform-approved read-only query that emits an unambiguous interface-revision field, capture structured pre/post output and correlate it with exact firmware identities and reboot timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact Intel ME/SPS generation and OS supported by the supplied utility documentation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record utility, ME/SPS, BIOS, OS/kernel and MEI driver versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Obtain the platform/vendor ME/SPS interface query documentation; public source evidence was not assumed for this case.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the missing reboot/re-query and identity correlation explicit without changing the acceptance target.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; both correctness and persistence across reboot are required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected interface revision and validated read-only query syntax.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A tool may report ME firmware rather than the ME-BIOS interface revision; field identity must be proven before comparison.

project_override_considerations: A project supplies the expected revision, query and reboot plan. Missing inputs delay readiness but do not change full automation capability; a project result must identify the exact platform and baseline used.
expected_evidence: Platform/SKU, BIOS/ME/SPS/MEI driver and query-tool identity
Authoritative expected interface revision and comparison rule
Raw pre-reboot query, approved reboot/downtime/reconnect transcript and identical raw post-reboot query
Pre/post comparison, host/BMC/SEL health, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The criterion's after-reboot requirement extends the terse procedure but does not contradict it. The missing expected value and concrete query are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target field and persistence objective are understandable. Under V3.1, absent baseline/tool/reboot parameters do not create permanent BLOCKED status, and all core actions are electronically automatable after approval.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its read-only boundary and diagnostic collection but rejects PARTIAL because user-supplied baseline and approval do not reduce automation capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its missing-input and reboot safeguards but reclassifies BLOCKED to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under the locked readiness-versus-capability rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds a complete pre/reboot/post evidence chain and distinguishes Tool Result from engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents both guessed correctness and the false assumption that missing project inputs make the case blocked or partial; also closes the omitted persistence step.
independent_technical_reasoning: After the owner supplies a validated read-only field query and baseline, no manual physical or visual action is needed. A controlled reboot and reconnect are scriptable, so capability is FULLY AUTOMATABLE even though readiness and formal verdict remain pending.
